title: Erturul2
script:

-- Ertuğrul Hub | +1 Speed Keyboard Escape - Hız & Infinity Jump Paneli
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Eski GUI varsa temizle
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("SpeedEscapeHub") then
	CoreGui.SpeedEscapeHub:Destroy()
end

-- Arayüz Oluşturma
local SG = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
SG.Name = "SpeedEscapeHub"
SG.Parent = CoreGui
SG.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Ana Sürüklenebilir Panel
local Panel = Instance.new("Frame")
Panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 210)
Panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.4, -105)
Panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
Panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
Panel.Parent = SG

local UIC = Instance.new("UICorner")
UIC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
UIC.Parent = Panel

-- Başlık (Sürükleme Alanı)
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
Title.Text = "Ertuğrul Hub | Speed & Jump"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
Title.TextSize = 13
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.Parent = Panel

local TitleUIC = Instance.new("UICorner")
TitleUIC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
TitleUIC.Parent = Title

-- Panel Sürükleme Mantığı
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Panel.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
		end)
	end
end)
Title.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput and dragging then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		Panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)

-- 1. Hız Değiştirme Kutusu (İstediğin hızı yaz veya direkt 300 yap)
local SpeedBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
SpeedBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0, 35)
SpeedBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.22, 0)
SpeedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
SpeedBox.Text = "300"
SpeedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SpeedBox.TextSize = 13
SpeedBox.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
SpeedBox.Parent = Panel

local BoxUIC = Instance.new("UICorner")
BoxUIC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
BoxUIC.Parent = SpeedBox

-- Hızı Sabitleme / Uygulama Butonu
local SpeedBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
SpeedBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0, 35)
SpeedBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.42, 0)
SpeedBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 200)
SpeedBtn.Text = "Hızı Kalıcı Yap / Uygula"
SpeedBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SpeedBtn.TextSize = 12
SpeedBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
SpeedBtn.Parent = Panel

local SpeedBtnUIC = Instance.new("UICorner")
SpeedBtnUIC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
SpeedBtnUIC.Parent = SpeedBtn

-- 2. Infinity Jump Butonu
local JumpBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
JumpBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0, 38)
JumpBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.65, 0)
JumpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
JumpBtn.Text = "Infinity Jump: [ KAPALI ]"
JumpBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
JumpBtn.TextSize = 12
JumpBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
JumpBtn.Parent = Panel

local JumpBtnUIC = Instance.new("UICorner")
JumpBtnUIC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
JumpBtnUIC.Parent = JumpBtn

-- Hız Sabitleme Döngüsü (Kalıcı olarak 300 veya kutuya yazılan değerde kalır)
SpeedBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local targetSpeed = tonumber(SpeedBox.Text) or 300
	SpeedBtn.Text = "Hız Ayarlandı: " .. targetSpeed
	task.wait(1)
	SpeedBtn.Text = "Hızı Kalıcı Yap / Uygula"
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local targetSpeed = tonumber(SpeedBox.Text) or 300
	local char = Player.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
		local hum = char.Humanoid
		if hum.WalkSpeed ~= targetSpeed then
			hum.WalkSpeed = targetSpeed
		end
	end
end)

-- Infinity Jump Mantığı
local infActive = false
JumpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	infActive = not infActive
	if infActive then
		JumpBtn.Text = "Infinity Jump: [ AÇIK ]"
		JumpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 80)
	else
		JumpBtn.Text = "Infinity Jump: [ KAPALI ]"
		JumpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	end
end)

UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
	if infActive and Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
		Player.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	end
end)
